method: Actual packaged v10 launcher and real vendored PGlite, temporary loopback configuration and synthetic database only. Read-only cloud state is injected at the deployment-root write probe; /tmp is remapped into the owned fixture. This is local startup/restore evidence, not live Coze or durable multi-instance acceptance.

cases.name: writable
checks: Packaged launcher serves unchanged new UI and real enabled vendor backend without an app node_modules directory; hidden admin assets respond; old paths fail
Actual seed data restored; no default administrator; feedback writes and deletes use the independent journal; database closes and reopens

cases.name: readonly-bundle
checks: Packaged launcher serves unchanged new UI and real enabled vendor backend without an app node_modules directory; hidden admin assets respond; old paths fail
Actual seed data restored; no default administrator; feedback writes and deletes use the independent journal; database closes and reopens
Second startup reuses writable data and journal, does not extract the old bundle again

cases.name: active-release
checks: Stable launcher loads immutable release UI, vendor and backend with root configuration and pre-existing root data

cases.name: invalid-database
checks: Database failure is logged; static UI still serves; config disabled; protected API fails closed
